Title: Safari export blocked
Preview: Board meeting Thursday; half the team cannot export.
Text:
Export to CSV has been broken since Friday.
It works in Chrome, but half our team is on Safari and they can't pull reports at all.
We have a board meeting Thursday.

Title: Reproducible export defect
Preview: Every Safari export fails with a consistent error.
Text: CSV export fails every time in Safari 18. The Download button returns error 500. Chrome works. I can reproduce it with any report.

Title: Duplicate renewal charge
Preview: Customer asks for a refund after two charges.
Text: Our account was charged twice for the annual renewal. Please refund the duplicate charge before our finance review tomorrow.

Title: Checkout outage
Text: Checkout has returned HTTP 503 for the last 20 minutes. Customers cannot place orders, and we are losing sales right now.

Title: Quarterly report help
Preview: Account needs guidance on exporting a report.
Text: Could someone show us the best way to export the quarterly report? We are preparing for our customer review next month.

Title: Automated export notice
Preview: Machine-generated status email says the nightly export passed.
Text: AUTOMATED REPORT: Nightly CSV export completed successfully at 02:14 UTC. No errors detected.

Title: Unclear follow-up
Preview: The customer says it is broken again without details.
Text: It is broken again. Can someone take a look? We need this sorted soon.
